This update focuses on adjusting gameplay by adding item search points in specific locations and increasing the level of detail in the city map.

[h1]Building Loot[/h1]

The ground floors of buildings that serve as shops have been added in this update, allowing players to explore inside these stores.
Each shop is different, from clinics to even weapon shops, giving you the chance to prepare yourself before setting out on your journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/db090bdf9888aa917b1e1d02861f5c2179e3434f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/4f4efe21916c9d46bfb016f73bdea78048ca11d3.png[/img]

[h3]All shop listings in this update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Clinic
[*] Bar
[*] Restaurant
[*] Cafe
[*] Gunstore
[*] Cloth Shop
[*] Minimart
[/list]

[h1]Glass Breaking[/h1]

This is a system we’ve specifically added in this update, to go along with the introduction of ground-floor shops.
Players can now break windows attached to buildings — including regular houses and shopfronts under buildings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/6d32caa08384b55f06de9d703fdcc6b3d38528a5.png[/img]

When the glass breaks, infected can climb into the shop.
To prevent them from breaking in, you need to block the broken window openings and stay away from the windows.

And of course, you can smash glass cabinets to collect the items inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/3a444a0cd112c5288b3c3b812fd95ba1862046d1.png[/img]

In future updates, we plan to add a barricade system that will allow players to build and completely seal broken windows without leaving any gaps.

[h1]Reshade[/h1]

Adjusted color tones and lighting for improved visual quality, and increased the rendering distance of shadows.

notes.title: Development update 5
notes.notes:
This update focuses on fixing and improving core game systems to enhance performance during gameplay.

[h2]Performance[/h2]

We’ve now fixed performance issues related to foliage, including both rendering and framerate handling.
Previously, trees caused framerate drops, especially during the initial moment of chopping. This has now been resolved.

In addition, small debris like leaves or cans caused performance drops when players walked near them.
We’ve fixed this as well, and collecting items like leaf debris or cans will no longer affect framerate.

[h2]Fix animation[/h2]

We’ve fixed additional animation issues following the update that introduced freeform melee control.
This new system caused attack animations during jumping and crouching to not work correctly.
We’ve now addressed this. When the player is crouching or jumping, melee attacks will now follow the direction the player is facing.

[h2]FIX[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed vehicle rendering distance at long range.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update 2 : Recap
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="GRzBvTYANf4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][h1]Hello[/h1][p]

Previously, we released an update that changed the in-game environment quite significantly, especially in the city map, where the changes are clearly noticeable. However, we didn’t announce or share any development details regarding that update, as we were spending time researching and improving the game to achieve the best performance we possibly could. As of now, we’ve found a fairly clear method for improving the game’s performance. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/e8e0e71f1fb9d8f779daa8928b7305676672c1a1.png"][/img]
[/p][h1]Recap[/h1][p]
In the previous update that we didn’t officially announce, we made several performance improvements.
To boost the game’s performance, we focused on optimizing building-type objects, including structures, buildings, and architectural elements.
This was a task that required a lot of development time due to the complexity of designing and placing these buildings in a way that allows them to be reused efficiently.
We also made adjustments to the surrounding environment to support optimization.
Another system we’d like to introduce is "Visibility Proxy" a system created to assist with object loading across each map.

Details about this will follow next.

[/p][h2]Environment[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/420500a45d3c3842492bcc45bb20461326ed88ab.png"][/img]
We’ve improved the environment in the city map by adding more complexity and detail, while also optimizing the game.

This was done by placing objects to block the player’s line of sight, which helps reduce the rendering distance of objects in front of the player.
At the same time, this approach helps guide gameplay flow, allowing players to better understand the area they are currently exploring.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/40a4da2344a7c9c1c795292831af83988ba8f3fd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/e581ff865d3592ea2b1aebfef8b2d9ee8ee841cc.png"][/img]
[/p][h2]Improve Building Structure[/h2][p]
We’ve improved the building models to enhance their visual quality and add more detailed elements to the structures.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/7302ab43684d2812213232bb314ebe9c0f11dc75.png"][/img]
Players who explore the city map will notice that the appearance of many buildings has changed significantly,
But their positions remain the same in order to preserve the original gameplay structure.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/4d7c2637073f44b088bd3f747aedc03913cc1588.png"][/img]
[/p][h2]Improve Building Interior[/h2][p]
We’ve improved the building interiors to better match the structure and shape of each building, while also expanding the navigable space compared to the previous layout.
The new interiors are more complex and feature increased detail.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/a8fd3d550b142c190b231ee8fd00c6a87da9f13c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/6cd90c67335335ad3b246759d44729f7383cd05c.png"][/img]
[/p][h2]Optimization[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/eb41950e0bb1fc7690a0bbbed1b269c2a368a50e.png"][/img]
We’ve adjusted the LOD (Level of Detail) rendering for trucks to ensure they are visible from longer distances while also reducing memory load.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/c1133cf5570eb91cc9622b0f4763fd1df80c9825.png"][/img]
We’ve added long-distance object rendering using the HLOD (Hierarchical Level of Detail) system, a method that helps reduce memory load by generating simplified models for distant rendering.

[/p][previewyoutube="-CNhHqTofEE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
"Visibility Proxy" is a core system we developed to optimize complex scenes and dense object placement. It works by dividing the map into zones and rendering only the objects within zones that the player is close to.

This system supports prioritization of object rendering, allowing us to hide smaller zones inside larger zones.
For example, when the player is inside a large zone, only nearby smaller zones will be rendered.

It also supports hiding interior objects when the player is outside a building, and hiding certain exterior elements when the player is inside, helping to further reduce load and improve performance.

[/p][h2]Building[/h2][p]
We’ve improved the building models to better support higher-quality optimization.
We created modular models that can be reused to assemble various building configurations,
allowing us to create diverse environments and distinct locations more efficiently.

[/p][h1]End of recap[/h1][p]
[/p][h1]Current Update[/h1][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/e137f566e9825f445bae962080445490c5378852.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/065d9c68394b641909b75a35a8a0b6c4b86bc119.png"][/img]
This update will add a new type of vehicle to increase detail and interaction with the player, which is different from the previous vehicle type.
Here is the list of vehicles added in this update.
[list]
[*]   Ambulance
[*]   SUV
[*]   Police SUV
[*]   Taxi SUV
[/list]
Players can now explore vehicles more thoroughly, even opening doors to grab items directly for use.
Some vehicles with rear doors can also be interacted with by the player.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/4cc25695c3c90c1b27d35d6c4352347372d34236.png"][/img]
[/p][h1]FIX[/h1][p]
Fix electrical boxes so they can be looted in all locations
Fix terrain texture mipmaps to improve long-distance clarity
Fix the number of items that can be looted from vehicles
Fix vehicle door opening angles
Fix the item size of the watch
Fix the item size of the mobile phone
Fix the item size of the brick
Fix the item size of the can
Fix the loot quantity from the yellow power generator
Fix mailboxes so they can be looted in all locations
Fix player collision size
Fix camera movement when pulling back a bow
Fix light visibility at night — lights can now be seen from long distances

[/p][h3]Don't forget to follow us on our social media channels:[/h3][p]

notes.title: Development update 1
notes.notes:
[h1]HELLO[/h1][p]
We are currently focusing primarily on gameplay development, while also not forgetting the importance of game performance, which directly affects the overall player experience. At this time, we have a fairly solid roadmap to address performance improvements, and we hope you will be satisfied with the upcoming updates. But for now, let’s take a look at what’s included in this current update.

[/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/72e0131b7a78d3062e6f94efeb483f87d911ed6f.png"][/img]
We’ve improved some sections of the fences to allow bullets to pass through. Previously, there were certain types of fences where players could not shoot through, and we’ve now replaced all of them. These fence types had a significant negative impact on game performance.

[/p][h1]Truck Can Loot[/h1][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/cd659dba8793e725ca7691fe4e9ae6ece1981c88.png"][/img]
We’ve changed the trucks so that they can now be looted. When a player loots a truck, they will receive materials for crafting and essential survival items such as medicine and basic weapons. The loot contents vary, but the trucks will remain in the same locations even when players return to them later.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/3e35932a0c506e8bd9595caed261ab2ccb3f79bc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/d0848ae9421be0d776d1e7ab0b5a4fd697860e7e.png"][/img]
Trucks are scattered across the entire map, both in the city and desert areas. However, not every truck can be looted, so players will need to pay close attention. We are planning to add even more lootable trucks in the future, so please stay tuned for our upcoming updates.

[/p][h1]Electric Trap[/h1][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/9820001af89c94e3da3f60514bb54854a6fda368.png"][/img]
In this update, we’re starting with electricity systems. Generators are now linked to nearby shock traps. When a player activates the generator, it automatically powers shock traps within range. This feature is in its early testing phase, and we plan to expand it in future updates with more dynamic and fun fuel-connection mechanics across various devices.

[/p][h1]Optimization[/h1][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="rUfU1FeiKEU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
After Dead Metro began placing a large number of objects into the world, the game faced serious performance issues. As a result, we paused all other development and focused solely on optimization for nearly two months. Now, we’ve resolved almost all major performance problems. Framerate has doubled, from 40–60 FPS to 70–120+ FPS on the same hardware. There are still a few minor areas that need improvement, particularly with interactive foliage, such as collecting sticks, cans, and concrete blocks. However, these are no longer difficult tasks and will be gradually refined in upcoming updates.

[/p][h1]Fast Interaction[/h1][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/faf8e05ff93b124d5476e0692c3b5b6c437adff6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/0513c2361445006cd229a17442564fee3fe25faf.png"][/img]
Previously, inserting a battery into a shock trap or adding firewood to a campfire required opening the inventory of that object. In this update, you can now quickly interact by simply holding the item in your hand and using the interact button — no need to open menus. This system works with all fuel-dependent devices. Additionally, for plant beds, players can now hold a bag of fertilizer and interact directly to apply it.

[/p][h1]Build in city[/h1][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/58abd55bd72be6dee9862def7b379fb882b32659.png"][/img]
In previous updates, players weren’t allowed to place structures in city zones.
This was due to concerns about performance impact
and the risk of players straying from the intended gameplay flow.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/8bf7c84b4e1e2aa5da07469a4395ed34b1d26636.png"][/img]
However, this restriction went against the open-world survival experience we aim to create.

With this update, players now have creative freedom to build in city areas.
Height limitations still apply to keep gameplay balanced.

So go ahead — start building your home.

[/p][h1]Why the Delay[/h1][p]
At this point, we are still unable to clearly present the gameplay in a way that helps players fully understand how to play and experience it meaningfully. This is because we are in the process of adding essential assets for gameplay, alongside improving the game world’s environment to better guide players visually, for example, using landmarks or long-distance visual navigation cues to direct gameplay.

The current version of the infected still lacks excitement and does not deliver a satisfying gameplay experience. We are planning to improve various aspects, including their animation, the rewards players receive after defeating them, and more engaging gameplay mechanics.

These are the reasons and key factors why development and improvement must continue until we reach the gameplay quality we’re aiming for. We hope to eventually deliver a gameplay experience that truly satisfies players.

[/p][h3]Don't forget to follow us on our social media channels:[/h3][p]

notes.title: Dead Metro World & Interaction Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=tbIamS8MglM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]World Update [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/b2a42b3d686b250044f3dd02cfe4a06f33368556.png[/img]

We have once again improved the desert map, adding new environments, villages, and pathways for traveling through the desert. These changes increase exploration opportunities and enhance the depth and intrigue of discovering new locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/b3283cb4120f03d389f36ce932a70efca11a8ffe.png[/img]

Large open spaces captivate survivors, but standing atop a tall building or tower and looking out over the vast world fuels curiosity. You will be able to visually identify potential exploration sites and their distances. To support this, we have added tower props as vantage points for long-distance scouting. These structures also enhance environmental detail and act as landmarks for navigation. For instance, when approaching a city, you might spot a communication tower or a water tank before the city itself, helping you recognize significant locations in the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/b0d0f5636ca9faee070c3ea95ee2df96c02bb954.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/4ecec9d3af490fe931a7c7069e0118a38edc1b1a.png[/img]

The original map was already vast, but much of it remained underutilized. We have now added new locations for further exploration:

[list]
[*] Village
[*] Substation
[*] Gas Station
[*] New Vill Update
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/7884bb55ff72ee1e22b569b9cd2c98eea2c38af9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/bf49ef1af02f69b4cf3f1698fa30a1c2e6d05179.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/806a7e7ceefa190e8b1aebeae87082a99562f64d.png[/img]

[h2]Vehicle [T E S T][/h2]

Vehicles have now been introduced for initial testing! Future updates will focus on vehicle structure modifications, movement realism, and additional features.

You can find vehicles scattered throughout the desert map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/0da91dbe0249b9cba41d5006e52105441cf81872.png[/img]

[h2]Throwing Weapons[/h2]

We have added throwable weapons to enrich the gameplay. These include more than just knives and grenades—various in-game props can also be thrown. However, non-weapon props will deal less damage than knives or explosives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/1e6f2c299c93b9a01e04904a34e2caa0e0afe95d.png[/img]

Some throwable objects create noise that attracts infected. You can use this strategically to divert their attention and avoid direct encounters.

[h2]Player Movement[/h2]

Once again, we have refined the player animations. The previous movement felt less fluid than we intended. With this update, we have significantly improved animation quality, making movement smoother and more natural.

[h2]Loot Update[/h2]

Previously, item searching was limited to loot containers like boxes. Now, we have improved item placement by displaying lootable objects on shelves. When looking at a shelf, you will see the items available for pickup.

Kitchen storage units now support this feature as well, enhancing decision-making while looting and adding detail to the game world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/fc44dcea2cf7c1b37e0dba65e39d39307374294a.png[/img]

A minor issue from the previous update has been addressed: items on shelves were not highlighted when players got close, making it difficult to identify what was lootable. In this update, we have increased the item pickup range and made items above the player’s head visible.

[h2]Infected Movement[/h2]

The previously infected movement animations lacked continuity, with occasional automatic speed adjustments that were inconsistent with actual movement speed. We have revised these animations, ensuring more accurate and natural movement synchronization.

[h2]Development[/h2]

We are continuously working on ways to improve Dead Metro's development efficiency to ensure it is ready for early access.

One major improvement is the addition of an AI navigation system that enables infected to climb over obstacles dynamically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/30ea88311d16b0d54f9a8efb12a854955f0a93b1.png[/img]

Previously, manually setting AI navigation for every climbable obstacle was time-consuming, often taking days or weeks. Given the complex environments filled with buildings, walls, and barriers, this process delayed progress significantly. The new system automates this process, allowing us to focus more on designing immersive world details.

We have also expanded our prop library, adding various building and interior props. Since a large number of objects need to be placed in the world, this system streamlines development and world-building.

We hope you enjoy Dead Metro and the unique gameplay experiences we are creating for you!

notes.title: Dead Metro Interaction Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Features [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/074431ed3ac8766e06109135bbdc8d26dcbc762a.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Shelves 
[*] 3D Loot

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/ae67130681478d731ddc35a46cf633be28955eff.png[/img]

[h2]Barter System (test)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/cd5314e7d7ac6e6baac0a323488c3837a389fbda.png[/img]

You can find these NPCs in the city map and desert to trade items on an equal-value basis. Keep an eye out for them to make the best exchanges!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/3f8f0f961c4f678f58a795e93e9f03972719c1e0.png[/img]

You can drag the items you want to trade from your inventory into the trade slot. Watch the green bar—if it moves to the right, the trade is acceptable, and you can proceed with the exchange.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/3494c1991ca1a3b56ec81e7dbab3795b86163c13.png[/img]

Every character will check your inventory and display the exchange rates for the items you currently have. The Valuation window will show the trade rates, allowing you to evaluate whether the exchange is worthwhile. 

[h2]Barter Location[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/5a80b145e4dfc954068d2636416c6e1127a0a25b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/e0cac1b503b4e19bd47e6c5c1d990750da7b3784.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/32be8d7e8be9b15feaae85a7b8d3a60a44f421d2.png[/img]

[h2]Taking it to the next level![/h2]
We've upgraded the Dead Metro framework by adding a navigation system for AI to operate on prop structures. This enhancement significantly speeds up our scene design process, giving us more time to focus on other aspects of development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/dc8e0508dd4f286d0758a35b7d66ea48521db136.png[/img]

Fix (Upcoming)

[list]
[*] There may be placement issues or object collision problems when installing gun racks against house walls
[/list]

notes.title: Dead Metro Weapons & Parts Update
notes.notes:
This month's update focuses on improving gameplay and enhancing the environment of Dead Metro to present a richer survival experience in a post-apocalyptic world. We've made adjustments in several areas, including adding new resource-gathering locations for building player bases, introducing new item types, crafting tables, and implementing a new system. This system will become a standout feature of Dead Metro moving forward: the Weapon Customization System. Details about this new system can be found below.

[previewyoutube=FTeaTs0UjKc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Environment Update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/2e9bfbc53cae8ce3b204ee0f278521e0c3d894ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/b5e8036f9ea51652420c7e9662d919e8e3372bd8.png[/img]

After releasing the demo version of Dead Metro, we encountered significant challenges in presenting the city map scenes effectively. The main issue was how to create a city environment that feels realistic and immersive. Ideally, when looking out through a building, you should see other buildings stretching into the distance, showcasing the vastness of the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/2e3861e30ea5a2a79a2dbd5272356e4b7e7e77fd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/2ffcd47292d3d44d72d74b16e39a896fca1776a4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/2c4ed4677de45cdc2fbb2c5757215cab832ae347.png[/img]

However, early in development, we faced severe performance issues. As a temporary solution, we added tall walls around the city map to block the player's view of areas beyond the walls.

Now, we’ve resolved this issue. We’ve implemented a new building design that can serve as a background without significantly impacting performance. While tall walls have been removed, smaller walls remain to support the narrative, which will be expanded in future updates.


Additionally, in the desert area, the previously tall walls have also been removed. We’ve replaced them with mountain and forest backdrops to emphasize the vastness of the map and enhance immersion in the desert environment.

[h1]New Item[/h1]

We've introduced new items to enhance the diversity of loot and add more depth to the gameplay experience. These additions make it easier for players to gather essential resources for basic survival, ensuring a smoother start in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/ce3c2875fc7960f49f66809aeffd37e04d13fdbc.png[/img]

[h2]Crafting Items and Materials[/h2]
Players can now craft items and materials directly within their base using specialized crafting tables:

[list]
[*] [h3]Furnace[/h3]
A small furnace designed to smelt raw materials, creating components essential for crafting and building advanced items.
[*] [h3]Chemical Table[/h3]
A station for mixing chemicals, allowing players to craft tranquilizers, medical supplies, and other chemical-based tools.
[*] [h3]Rain Collector[/h3]
Accessing water has become more convenient with the introduction of the Rain Collector. This device collects rainwater, providing a steady supply of water. Players can refill bottles at any time, making it vital to carry water bottles, especially for long journeys.
[*] [h3]Granden Stove[/h3]
We’ve added the Granden Stove, a grill designed for preparing meals served in plate form. This addition enhances the cooking experience, providing players with new ways to create and enjoy more refined dishes in Dead Metro.
[/list]

[h1]Weapon Customization System[/h1]

In previous updates, stealth gameplay was challenging. Even the slightest noise could attract infected to attack you, and firearms naturally produce loud sounds. With no weapon customization system in place, stealthy approaches were limited.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/60c1591b599b4cda265c040efe807cc6f533ded6.png[/img]

In this update, we’re introducing the Weapon Customization System, starting with the Silencer—an essential attachment for sneaking past and eliminating infected without drawing attention. When a silencer is equipped, firing your weapon in close proximity to infected no longer generates loud noises.

[h2]Silencer Types[/h2]
Silencers are categorized by their compatibility with specific firearm types:

[list]
[*] [h3]Pipe Silencer[/h3]
Supports Submachine Guns (SMG) and Pistols.
[*] [h3]Oil Filter Silencer[/h3]
Supports Assault Rifles (AR), Sniper Rifles (SR), and Designated Marksman Rifles (DMR).
[*] [h3]Gas Can Silencer[/h3]
Supports Shotguns (SG).
[/list]

This update expands stealth gameplay options, offering new strategies to tackle infected and survive more effectively.

[h1]Basic Tools[/h1]

For players starting their journey in Dead Metro, early gameplay could feel tedious and frustrating due to the excessive time spent searching for tools to chop wood or dismantle cars for metal. To address this, we’ve introduced Basic Tools in this update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/04d28036d4df1b042fbf411707dccaab2719dfe1.png[/img]

[h2]Can Mace[/h2]
A beginner tool for smashing cars to collect metal. It can be crafted from wood and cans found on the streets.

[h2]Stone Axe & Stone Pickaxe[/h2]
Added to give players quick access to tools for chopping wood and mining metal.

Additionally, almost all melee weapons now double as tools for resource gathering, depending on their stats. Players can check an item's details to see if it has the following:

[list]
[*] [h3]Wood Damage[/h3]
Indicates the weapon or tool's capability to chop trees for gathering wood. 
[*] [h3]Mining Damage[/h3]
Reflects the ability of the weapon or tool to extract minerals or metal.
[/list]

[h1]Ground Loot[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/5308cbedaa4d31533ef4caf626a61f95beddd33f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/aa1a3046686946c50e68baeee6db96b90e2fee21.png[/img]

Surviving the early stages of the game could be time-consuming when gathering materials for crafting tools and melee weapons. To streamline the process, we’ve increased the amount of loot available on the ground. This makes the early survival phase more manageable and less time-intensive.

[h1]Building Part Update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/3475fefddbb00baac7699147dc1f48e466e36071.png[/img]

We’ve revamped the appearance of building structures to enhance base customization and make a building more visually appealing. While the older base structures conveyed a sense of realism by reflecting materials scavenged from the post-apocalyptic world, we believe that aesthetics and player satisfaction are equally important. This update adds more visually appealing designs for your bases.

[h1]Furniture[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/950e3dfa234a1021e79d67fda9f6233472948b6f.png[/img]

For players who enjoy decorating their bases, we’ve added new furniture to foster creativity and make your base feel more personal and vibrant.

[h2]Note[/h2]
[h3][u]At this time, some furniture pieces may only serve as props for decorating your home. However, in the future, we plan to add functionality to them, such as tables that can hold decorative items.[/u][/h3]

[h1]Fix[/h1]

[h2]Forest[/h2]

In reality, deserts have very few trees, making it difficult to source materials for building shelters or crafting tools. When applying this environment to Dead Metro, it created accessibility issues for player resources. To address this, we’ve improved the desert map by adding trees. This change ensures players can gather the necessary materials more easily for crafting and base building, significantly enhancing gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/dfdb660b5b54d1270424c3abb349b12fc4f7531b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/6479d3a44c6c4715e090fd9b934d4221ed3c5292.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/ea59875f81c816a92f85d6b4837ce20bcdd68c73.png[/img]

[h2]Loot box[/h2]

In the initial release of Dead Metro’s demo, finding resources was challenging due to unclear indicators of where to start searching. To resolve this, we’ve updated loot points to be more visible by introducing brightly colored loot boxes. These boxes are now easier to identify, making the search for resources less frustrating and more intuitive for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/9bc7305a5b12a37dded0914bdc083352ce290688.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/cbd860bdb067c15acfc57d16e897cbc7bb199f9f.png[/img]

[h2]Tree-Cutting Mechanic[/h2]

Trees in urban areas can now be cut down to gather wood for crafting tools and building bases. Beyond resource gathering, this mechanic offers strategic advantages. For example, if a tree blocks your line of sight while setting up an ambush in a parking lot, you can cut it down to clear a path and improve visibility.

We’re grateful to all players who enjoy Dead Metro. If you have any feedback or suggestions, you can join our Discord community through our Steam page. Your insights and critiques are invaluable as we continue to improve and expand Dead Metro.

Thank you!

notes.title: Dead Metro Loot Update
notes.notes:
We would like to start by thanking you for your continued support of Dead Metro and for your patience as we work on updates. We apologize for the delay in this latest update; our team has dedicated a lot of time to adding interiors to various buildings. These new areas will provide safe spaces where you can catch your breath after encountering the many infected. They are designed to be a haven for you to prepare and strategize before facing the infected once more. 

[previewyoutube=3YWZeLRt8zo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Interiors[/h1]
The new lootable interiors introduced in this update give you ample time to gather resources before returning to the action. While these areas may be safe from the infected, they are not guaranteed to be safe from other players. Always remain vigilant when exploring these spaces in search of valuable resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/461b1125bc2d9e983aebec3819c5e2d2498bd87c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/2e934d72b96b8f0d6085be2510200cb38a750cb4.png[/img]

[h1]Loot[/h1]
We have introduced new items in Dead Metro to enhance your resource collection experience.

[h1]Sound[/h1]
We have enhanced the sound effects of regular infected to make them sound more realistic. However, the louder sounds may occasionally annoy players. This feature is still being refined.

[h1]Explorer’s Luck[/h1]
We have made adjustments to the loot drop rates as a first step toward balancing the game. Please note that this system is still a work in progress and may require further refinement in the future. At the moment, the drop rates might feel inconsistent because of the complexity involved in balancing item probabilities.

We are dedicated to improving this feature to ensure it enhances your gameplay experience.

[h1]Scrap Trade[/h1]
You can now exchange scrap for essential starter items such as resources, water, and food, particularly in regions where resources are limited.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/b9ba353427287930acf83e8787c83efee8d3ff6f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/46c969bf02867fbbcbcc54b8c86d83d9bc6a07b3.png[/img]

[h1]Resource Chopping[/h1]
You can now collect basic materials, such as wood and metal, on the city map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/a14d726fbf16dd077dc79238560aa46b2ea90fe1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/3af5301632dcd9f5c36df9e8a455625e122f9e9e.png[/img]

[h1]Melee Box[/h1]
We’ve improved melee weapon crates. These crates, containing melee weapons, can now be found in Radwall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/298b6ea4b5cc9a0404a96325096fae7f6045ebfe.png[/img]

notes.title: Dead Metro Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=AtNgA4MuXOM;full][/previewyoutube]
We have made our first update by introducing systems and scenes that better align with the gameplay.

[h1]GRAPHIC UPDATE[/h1]
We have improved the lighting effects on each map to enhance their visual appeal. The lighting, colors, and atmosphere have been updated to create a more immersive experience. Shadows now vary in intensity and detail, with each angle reflecting the interaction of light in a more dynamic way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/a7d4433eb3ae7e9fa04e9c28da22f84dfbf3fc68.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/cf3544c4fc1717a200b631fd6ebcf0a3cbfd55c1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/976f4b78a4161d68815b22ddfd8e64e683bb421b.png[/img]

[h1]RED WALL[/h1]
The area was previously a restricted zone for experiments and storage of supplies, so there are many items left behind. However, it is also inhabited by numerous infected individuals. Ensure you are fully prepared before entering the Redwall; otherwise, you may not make it out alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/6f25c04d5ef6ecfed6adadb2eb0d179a4a077bf4.png[/img]

[h1]ANIMATION[/h1]
We have enhanced character movement to make it more agile and responsive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/c70e955df7eaf935cd69d015735c81f32bb358c3.gif[/img]

[h1]PLAY GROUND[/h1]
We have introduced a new map where you can try out equipment and items in the Playground, helping you prepare before entering the open-world maps of Dead Metro.
[list]
[*] Test range
[*] Zombie area
[*] Loot
[*] Melee box
[*] Movement test
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/62d8a21f19eb2852a627169858b5895f7ba4f8dc.png[/img]

[h1]MAP[/h1]
The map is now available! Press the 'M' key in unfamiliar areas. The map includes icons for each location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/5ec682fae2e912e3d01a695919cdeaea09ed5d16.png[/img]

[h1]JOURNALS[/h1]
Now you will have enough information to survive in DEAD METRO. We have added journals to inform you about the information in DEAD METRO. Sometimes we will include instructions on how to use items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159995/0711171aa293fa68fdd5f67864fbb4588f895797.png[/img]

[h1][Bug][/h1]
[list]
[*] Character Movement Stuck While Walking: Fixed an issue where the player’s character would become stuck while walking.
[*] Crafting Freeze in Online Mode: Resolved an issue where crafting would freeze in online mode.
[*] Base Part Display Error After Upgrade: Corrected the display issue where base parts would show incorrectly after upgrading.
[*] Settings Not Saving: Fixed a bug preventing settings from being saved properly.
[/list]

[h1][u]The above [BUG] items will be fixed soon.[/u][/h1]
